summary:
Independent TASK-0136 local Node V2 design review APPROVE, with no critical/high/medium or other findings. Actual reviewer /root/node_v2_design_review did not author the task specification, normative contract, production code, companion tests or predecessor primitive. This is a design decision only, not implementation, verification, execution permission, authenticated human/model identity or completed integration.

Independently read the frozen TASK-0136 specification, task/risk/classification facts, normative docs/superpowers/specs/node-v2-installed-lifecycle.md at the declared base, Task3 of the integration plan and the narrowly relevant existing approval/review interfaces. The real task remains WAITING_FOR_SPEC_REVIEW on codex/agent-bridge-node-v2. Base and subject are both5a802cd1bb60a23d01bc0fa0a7922026176855f6, frozen spec175297e180eea6b459a6d17ef4ca3010ef759fa35abd058a9ea689bf35535fac, classification2de2d3c652cdb3c37b7ae227dc315d298ac97dffad3227695799f72d5e1a3b6c, native Policyfac8afbe8e1f671338eadc02697a66a3c6aa9ca5494eb25ea97b80812bce4727. The deterministic route is REVIEW and verification V2, with explicit acceptance, integration, targeted mutation and independent-verifier requirements. One clear authorized local profile/lifecycle direction is declared; no invented ASK direction or risk downgrade is used.

The allowed source modules and two schemas cover the complete atomic consumer map: Policy/version and classification entry, initialization and CLI, fixed planning/execution/coverage, evidence/snapshot, verifier and service transitions, review, approval and marker recovery, freshness/status and Gate, plus installed authority/probes. Native Policy2.6, native evidence1.0/2.0, Node revision1/3.1, the five native operators, thresholds85/90 and existing check argv remain unchanged. New revision2/Policy3.2/evidence3.2 is explicit and disjoint; CI stays unavailable. Safe test/document paths are limited transport of separate task-free commits, not authority to mix ownership or lower routing. Prerequisite TASK-0135 history transport is narrowly named and append-only; normal merge preserves its independently authored evidence and completion history. Neither arbitrary authorization-file maintenance nor target application is in scope.

The source base already contains the prerequisite primitive but no Node revision2 production implementation. Independently read the retained direct and sdist-rebuilt ordinary acceptance summaries and their exact digests: direct82a57f147c1c9dc3837d721ba20517d402c74f0e54fed82b84fccabae3edf6ad and rebuilt279f7b8107b8cf7bcdc4f505f6fdfaf128f4ec9994d714692f6ac6da020c5685. Each reports current/all_killed/passed, five killed results, ten actual Jobs, one consumption, zero forbidden replay attempts and spent-action rejection. This satisfies the stated ordinary-primitive prerequisite for unpublished separate-branch work. It does not establish predecessor full native verification, Gate or CI; publication must still wait for those actual predecessor conditions. This review did not inspect or operate an inherited live process handle and does not claim that pending pipeline has passed.

The coverage design uses one bound official all-zero Istanbul producer/remapper and an independent original-TS AST/wire certificate, with complete source manifest, fixed tool/dependency/provider/config bytes, retained raw originals and unchanged budgets. Its two narrow exceptions are producer/AST-bijective implicit-else sentinels and certified empty named reexports; all other malformed ranges, counters, fields, absent executable files and unknown production inputs reject. It does not clamp negative hits, manufacture coordinates, edit runtime raw reports, derive the zero domain from successful hit data or weaken revision1. The required parser/operator/control negatives and actual ordinary execution remain concrete acceptance work for the implementation, not an inference from the research catalog.

The five exact offline product tuples are backed by the same complete fixed coverage-suite report and actual process receipts. Every report row and counter is checked; each selected tuple is unique and passed while legitimate repeated non-selected parameterized rows are preserved and counted. JSON success alone does not prove no unhandled errors. The fixed callback-free config SHA74bed4fc135f16dd29e85987c221ab2d877a778fa44e774dcc5dbc4a646654ed, explicit owned-checkout --config and official --dangerouslyIgnoreUnhandledErrors=false close that runner boundary without inventing a JSON errors field or custom reporter. The actual bound Vitest4.1.10 resolveProjects path was additionally inspected: absent projects it uses the default project, and the old workspace option throws rather than discovering a competing legacy workspace. Changed config/filter/plugin input is explicitly unsupported; actual future fixed-argv execution is still required.

The single completed selected IMUT is the sole owned run. Preparation/recording stay IMPLEMENTING-only with exact current single-use approval and claims. Node role creation is exclusive before state transition, and subsequent attempts cannot reuse partial output. Task/version/tree/spec/Policy/classification/verifier context and installed engine bytes bind both originals. The closed parent plus complete Node inventory and immutable pre archive avoid a second ignored root, broad directory exemption, second caller-trusted Current type or cyclic future-run hash. Finalization changes only phase and implementation reference; the same verifier/context, stable snapshot, immutable originals and complete current checks must remain valid. Implementation review binds snapshot and code approval binds full final evidence SHA.

The flat replay graph is explicit: Node original-material recheck validates its own data and collects/pure-replays installed facts once, returning an appended optional typed fact to existing shared approval/Gate guards; it does not call review builders, public approval/Gate/status or marker completion. Native callers retain the existing loader path and missing facts never default to success. The existing marker validator interface already accepts supplied current task/event/approval/review facts. The new code-marker branch must purely validate the exact final digest, stable-snapshot context and registered current review, without recovery, recursive Node replay or subprocesses; completion performs its one full current recheck before existing writes. Executing prepare/record and all other invalid/foreign/stale marker cases retain rejection. This is implementable through the identified existing interfaces and requires no extra registry, cache or transaction framework.

All five installed probes must exercise actual Node guards and public reachability while preserving native positive controls, four reusable operators, the narrow installed001 transformation and exactly one designated call-phase AssertionError per killed mutant. Fixed offline product tests are not real model/SDK/WeChat/phone calls. Full ordinary wheel and rebuilt-wheel lifecycle, reject-path and no-process/no-write replay evidence; complete current native V2, both85/90 coverage domains, all required checks, independent implementation review, same-verifier finalization, code approval/Gate and exact-head source CI remain mandatory. No source checkout evidence or historical native PASS replaces ordinary-installed acceptance. Atomic public activation follows integration of every consumer; no Node CI or real-target adoption is claimed.

The scope is bounded to the requested local lifecycle and necessary gates. Parallel ownership and sequential integration are stated, and tests/docs remain separate. Current standing authorization permits a spec decision after valid frozen facts and this independent design APPROVE; final verify is not a prerequisite to recording spec approval. The project owner or authorized integrator still records it through the CLI. This review performed no approval/consumption, source or task-ledger mutation, verify, Job, engine, network delivery, target write, credentials/private upload, paid call, settings/authorization edit, threshold change, history rewrite or final completion claim.
